decisions.reason: The Jewish blessing of God (meaning decision m1) is said in Amharic with the verb "ባረከ": "ይባረክ" (blessed be) is the living form of praise, and it keeps the link with "ባረከን" (he blessed us) that follows. Readable says the plain "ይመስገን", as the English Readable says "Praise".

decisions.choice: ልጅነት (adoption, L, B) and የራሱ ልጆች (his own children, B, R), with no gender span
alternatives: {{gender:ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች|ወንዶች ልጆች}}, following the English span
decisions.reason: As in Romans 8: "ልጅነት" and "ልጆች" already include daughters, and "ወንዶች ልጆች" would stress maleness, which is not the point here; the son's standing as heir is carried by "ልጅነት" and, at Readable, by "የልጆቹን መብት ሁሉ" (all the rights of his children).

decisions.choice: {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} (verse 3); {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} where the Greek has the article (verses 10, 12)
decisions.reason: The alternative takes the definite ending "-ኡ" only where Paul writes "the Christ", so a reader who chooses "መሲሕ" can see the difference the English Literal shows with "the".

source.text: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν, ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ ἁγίῳ, ὅ ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν, εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως, εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: In whom also you, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of the salvation of you, in whom also having believed you were sealed with the Spirit of the promise the Holy, \v 14 which is [the] pledge of the inheritance of us, for [the] redemption of the possession, for [the] praise of the glory of him.

en.L: In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you also, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of your salvation, in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} also, having believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of the promise, \v 14 who is [the] down payment of our inheritance, for [the] redemption of [God's own] possession, to [the] praise of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.B: And you also are in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You heard the message of truth, the gospel that brings you salvation, and you believed; and in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you were sealed with the Holy Spirit God had promised. \v 14 The Spirit is the down payment on our inheritance, until God redeems those who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own possession, so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory will be praised.
en.R: You also are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. You heard the message of truth, the good news that God saves you. When you believed it, God put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} seal on you: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave you the Holy Spirit {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had promised. This seal shows that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 14 The Spirit is like a first payment that guarantees the rest. God will give us everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised. The day is coming when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will set free completely the people who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own. Then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory will be praised.

es.L: En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, habiendo oído la palabra de la verdad, el evangelio de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} salvación, en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también, habiendo creído, {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} sellados con el Espíritu Santo de la promesa, \v 14 que es anticipo de nuestra herencia, para [la] redención de la posesión [de Dios], para alabanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.B: Y también {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. {{plural_you:Oyeron|Oísteis}} el mensaje de la verdad, el evangelio que {{plural_you:les|os}} trae salvación, y {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}; y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} sellados con el Espíritu Santo que Dios había prometido. \v 14 El Espíritu es el anticipo de nuestra herencia, hasta que Dios redima a los que son {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia posesión, para que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria sea alabada.
es.R: También {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. {{plural_you:Oyeron|Oísteis}} el mensaje de la verdad, la buena noticia de que Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} salva. Cuando lo {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}, Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} puso {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sello: {{plural_you:les|os}} dio el Espíritu Santo que había prometido. Ese sello muestra que {{plural_you:son|sois}} de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 14 El Espíritu es como un primer pago que garantiza el resto. Dios nos dará todo lo que ha prometido. Viene el día en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} liberará por completo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria será alabada.

sw.L: Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ninyi pia, mliposikia neno la kweli, Injili ya wokovu wenu, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pia, mlipoamini, mlitiwa muhuri kwa Roho Mtakatifu wa ahadi, \v 14 ambaye ni malipo ya awali ya urithi wetu, kwa ukombozi wa mali [ya Mungu], kwa sifa ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Nanyi pia mko ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Mlisikia ujumbe wa kweli, Injili inayowaletea wokovu, mkaamini; na ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mlitiwa muhuri kwa Roho Mtakatifu ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi. \v 14 Roho ndiye malipo ya awali ya urithi wetu, mpaka Mungu atakapowakomboa wale walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ili utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usifiwe.
sw.R: Ninyi pia mmeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Mlisikia ujumbe wa kweli, Habari Njema kwamba Mungu anawaokoa. Mlipoiamini, Mungu aliweka muhuri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu yenu: aliwapa Roho Mtakatifu aliyekuwa ameahidi. Muhuri huu unaonyesha kwamba ninyi ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \v 14 Roho ni kama malipo ya kwanza yanayohakikisha kwamba yaliyobaki yatakuja. Mungu atatupa kila kitu alichoahidi. Siku inakuja ambapo atawaweka huru kabisa watu walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Hapo ndipo utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utasifiwa.

fr.L: En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous aussi, ayant entendu la parole de la vérité, l’Évangile de votre salut, en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi, ayant cru, vous avez été scellés de l’Esprit Saint de la promesse, \v 14 qui est [l’]acompte de notre héritage, pour [la] rédemption de [ce que Dieu s’est] acquis, à [la] louange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.B: Vous aussi, vous êtes en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Vous avez entendu le message de la vérité, l’Évangile qui vous apporte le salut, et vous avez cru ; et en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous avez été marqués du sceau de l’Esprit Saint que Dieu avait promis. \v 14 L’Esprit est l’acompte de notre héritage, en attendant que Dieu rachète pleinement ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent, pour que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire soit louée.
fr.R: Vous aussi, vous êtes unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Vous avez entendu le message de la vérité, la bonne nouvelle que Dieu vous sauve. Quand vous y avez cru, Dieu a mis {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} marque sur vous : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a donné l’Esprit Saint qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait promis. Cette marque montre que vous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenez. \v 14 L’Esprit est comme un premier versement qui garantit le reste : Dieu nous donnera tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promis. Le jour vient où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} libérera complètement ceux qui sont {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Alors {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire sera louée.

ko.L: 그 안에서 여러분도 진리의 말씀, 곧 여러분의 구원의 복음을 듣고, 그 안에서 믿어, 약속의 성령으로 인치심을 받았습니다. \v 14 이 성령은 우리 유산의 보증금이시며, [하나님의] 소유를 속량하시기까지 [주신 것이니], 그분의 영광을 찬송하게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 여러분도 그분 안에 있습니다. 여러분은 진리의 말씀, 곧 여러분에게 구원을 가져다주는 복음을 듣고 믿었습니다. 그리고 그분 안에서 하나님께서 약속하신 성령으로 인치심을 받았습니다. \v 14 성령께서는 우리가 받을 유산의 보증금이 되십니다. 하나님께서 그분의 소유인 백성을 온전히 속량하실 때까지 그러하십니다. 그리하여 그분의 영광이 찬송을 받게 하시려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 여러분도 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 하나가 되었습니다. 여러분은 진리의 말씀, 곧 하나님께서 여러분을 구원하신다는 기쁜 소식을 들었습니다. 여러분이 그것을 믿었을 때, 하나님께서는 여러분에게 그분의 도장을 찍으셨습니다. 곧 그분이 약속하신 성령을 주셨습니다. 이 도장은 여러분이 그분의 것이라는 것을 보여 줍니다. \v 14 성령께서는 나머지도 반드시 주시겠다고 보증하는 첫 지불금과 같습니다. 하나님께서는 그분이 약속하신 모든 것을 우리에게 주실 것입니다. 하나님께서 그분의 백성을 완전히 자유롭게 하실 날이 오고 있습니다. 그때 그분의 영광이 찬양을 받을 것입니다.

vi.L: Trong Đấng ấy, anh chị em cũng vậy, sau khi đã nghe lời chân lý, là Tin Lành về sự cứu rỗi của anh chị em, cũng trong Đấng ấy, khi đã tin, anh chị em được đóng ấn bằng Đức Thánh Linh của lời hứa, \v 14 là Đấng bảo chứng cho cơ nghiệp của chúng ta, cho đến sự cứu chuộc những người thuộc về [Đức Chúa Trời], để ca ngợi vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Anh chị em cũng ở trong Đấng ấy. Anh chị em đã nghe sứ điệp chân lý, là Tin Lành đem đến sự cứu rỗi cho anh chị em, và anh chị em đã tin; và trong Đấng ấy, anh chị em đã được đóng ấn bằng Đức Thánh Linh mà Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa. \v 14 Thánh Linh là tiền đặt cọc bảo đảm cơ nghiệp của chúng ta, cho đến khi Đức Chúa Trời cứu chuộc những người thuộc quyền sở hữu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được ca ngợi.
vi.R: Anh chị em cũng được hiệp nhất với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Anh chị em đã nghe sứ điệp chân lý, là Tin Lành rằng Đức Chúa Trời cứu anh chị em. Khi anh chị em tin, Đức Chúa Trời đã đóng ấn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên anh chị em: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho anh chị em Đức Thánh Linh mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa. Ấn ấy cho thấy anh chị em thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 14 Thánh Linh giống như khoản tiền trả trước để bảo đảm phần còn lại. Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban cho chúng ta mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hứa. Ngày ấy đang đến, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giải thoát trọn vẹn những người là dân riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Khi đó vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ được ca ngợi.

pt.L: Nele também vocês, tendo ouvido a palavra da verdade, o evangelho da salvação de vocês, {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} também, tendo crido, foram selados com o Espírito Santo da promessa, \v 14 que é [a] primeira parcela da nossa herança, para [a] redenção da propriedade [de Deus], para [o] louvor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória.
pt.B: E vocês também estão {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}. Vocês ouviram a mensagem da verdade, o evangelho que lhes traz a salvação, e creram; e {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} vocês foram selados com o Espírito Santo que Deus havia prometido. \v 14 O Espírito é a primeira parcela da nossa herança, até que Deus redima os que são a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} propriedade, para que a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória seja louvada.
pt.R: Vocês também estão unidos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}. Vocês ouviram a mensagem da verdade, as boas-novas de que Deus salva vocês. Quando vocês acreditaram nelas, Deus pôs em vocês o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} selo: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a vocês o Espírito Santo que tinha prometido. Esse selo mostra que vocês pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \v 14 O Espírito é como um primeiro pagamento que garante o restante. Deus vai nos dar tudo o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} prometeu. Está chegando o dia em que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai libertar por completo as pessoas que são {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}}. Então a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória será louvada.

am.L: በእርሱ እናንተ ደግሞ የእውነትን ቃል፣ የመዳናችሁን ወንጌል ሰምታችሁ፣ በእርሱም ደግሞ አምናችሁ፣ በተስፋ ቃሉ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ታተማችሁ፤ \v 14 እርሱም የርስታችን ቀብድ ነው፤ [የእግዚአብሔር] ንብረት ለሆኑት ቤዛነት፣ ለክብሩም ምስጋና።
am.B: እናንተም ደግሞ በእርሱ ናችሁ። የእውነትን ቃል፣ መዳንን የሚያመጣላችሁን ወንጌል ሰማችሁ፤ አመናችሁም፤ በእርሱም እግዚአብሔር ተስፋ በሰጠው በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ታተማችሁ። \v 14 እግዚአብሔር የራሱ ንብረት የሆኑትን እስኪቤዥ ድረስ መንፈስ ቅዱስ የርስታችን ቀብድ ነው፤ ይህም ክብሩ እንዲመሰገን ነው።
am.R: እናንተም ደግሞ {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር አንድ ሆናችኋል። የእውነትን መልእክት፣ እግዚአብሔር እንደሚያድናችሁ የሚናገረውን የምሥራች ሰማችሁ። ባመናችሁም ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ማኅተሙን አተመባችሁ፤ ተስፋ የሰጠውን መንፈስ ቅዱስን ሰጣችሁ። ይህ ማኅተም የእርሱ መሆናችሁን ያሳያል። \v 14 መንፈስ ቅዱስ ቀሪው ክፍያ እንደሚከተል የሚያረጋግጥ የመጀመሪያ ክፍያ ነው። እግዚአብሔር ተስፋ የሰጠንን ሁሉ ይሰጠናል። የራሱ የሆኑትን ሰዎች ፈጽሞ ነጻ የሚያወጣበት ቀን ይመጣል። ያን ጊዜ ክብሩ ይመሰገናል።

decisions.choice: the praise of verses 3-12 goes on: "in whom" is Christ, and the refrain closes it a third time
alternatives: a new sentence with a new subject
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT marks a pause after verse 12, but ἐν ᾧ picks up "in the Christ" from the end of verse 12, and "to the praise of his glory" ends the whole passage as it ended verses 6 and 12.

decisions.choice: "you also": the Gentile readers, who have come to share what "we" have; "our inheritance" joins both
alternatives: "you" and "we" are the same people, with no contrast
decisions.reason: καὶ ὑμεῖς sets the readers beside the "we" of verses 11-12 (see the note there). Verse 14 then speaks of "our" inheritance, which Jews and Gentiles share alike, as 2:11-22 and 3:6 say at length.

decisions.choice: the sentence starts again with a second "in whom"; the main verb is "you were sealed"
alternatives: "having believed in him" (Christ as the one believed in)
decisions.reason: After ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες the sentence breaks off and resumes with ἐν ᾧ. The main verb, ἐσφραγίσθητε, comes only here: in Christ, when they believed, they were sealed.

decisions.choice: the word of the truth is the gospel that brings their salvation
alternatives: a true word that belongs to the gospel
decisions.reason: The two phrases describe one message, as in Colossians 1:5: the message is the truth, and that message is the gospel that saves them.

decisions.choice: sealed: marked as God's own and kept safe
decisions.reason: A seal pressed in wax marked a document or goods as belonging to their owner and kept them from tampering. ἐσφραγίσθητε says God has marked believers as his by giving them the Spirit (4:30; 2 Corinthians 1:22).

decisions.choice: the Spirit of the promise: the Holy Spirit whom God promised through the prophets and through Jesus
decisions.reason: God promised to pour out his Spirit and put it within his people (Joel 2:28-29; Ezekiel 36:26-27); Jesus spoke of "the promise of the Father" (Acts 1:4; 2:33), and Paul says the Gentiles too receive the promised Spirit through faith (Galatians 3:14).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: ὅ, a neuter "which", agreeing with "Spirit"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ between the neuter and the masculine form of the relative pronoun. Both refer to the Holy Spirit, and the meaning does not change. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: down payment: a first installment that guarantees the full payment will follow
alternatives: a pledge given as security and later returned
decisions.reason: ἀρραβὼν is a trade word, borrowed from Hebrew, for money paid at the start of a deal to bind the buyer to pay the rest. The Spirit is both part of the inheritance, already given, and God's guarantee that the rest will come (2 Corinthians 1:22; 5:5).

decisions.choice: the redemption of God's own possession: the day God sets his people fully free
alternatives: until we take possession of our inheritance
decisions.reason: περιποιήσεως means something acquired and kept as one's own. In the Old Testament God's people are his treasured possession (Exodus 19:5), and the Greek Old Testament uses this word for them in Malachi 3:17, and 1 Peter 2:9 calls the church "a people for his possession". It could instead mean the believers' coming into possession of the inheritance. Either way, the redemption here is the final one, still ahead (4:30).

decisions.choice: who
decisions.reason: The pronoun refers to the Holy Spirit; English does not call the Spirit "which" or "it", whatever the Greek gender of the word.

decisions.choice: down payment
decisions.reason: "Down payment" keeps the trade picture and its point: part now, the rest to come (m8). "Guarantee" keeps only the second half; "deposit" can suggest money that will be returned.

decisions.choice: This seal shows that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; a first payment that guarantees the rest. God will give us everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised
alternatives: you were sealed; the down payment on our inheritance
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two pictures, the seal (m5) and the down payment (m8), and says what "our inheritance" is, using the wording of the Ephesians word list.

decisions.choice: until God redeems those who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own possession (B); when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will set free completely the people who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own (R)
alternatives: for the redemption of the possession
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the sense chosen in m9. Readable uses "set free" for redemption, as in verse 7.

decisions.choice: You also are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ and explains "in him", as in verses 3-12.

decisions.choice: anticipo (L, B); un primer pago que garantiza el resto (R)
decisions.reason: "Arras" is the traditional term but today mostly names the coins of a wedding rite or a legal deposit; "garantía" keeps only the promise. "Anticipo" is a part paid now with the rest to follow, the trade picture of m8.

decisions.choice: malipo ya awali (L, B); malipo ya kwanza yanayohakikisha kwamba yaliyobaki yatakuja (R)
decisions.reason: "Arabuni" is the borrowed trade word but few readers know it today; "dhamana" (guarantee, security) keeps only the promise. "Malipo ya awali" (first payment) says part is paid now and the rest will follow (m8).

decisions.choice: l’acompte (L, B); un premier versement qui garantit le reste (R)
decisions.reason: "Acompte" is the French trade word for a first part of a price that commits the buyer to pay the rest, which is the picture (m8). "Gage" and "garantie" keep only the promise; "arrhes" can be forfeited, which is not the point.

decisions.choice: scellés (L); marqués du sceau (B); a mis {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} marque (R)
decisions.reason: French "sceller" today mostly means to fix in place or to close a letter; Balanced names the seal itself, a mark of ownership and protection (m5), and Readable says "marque" and what it shows.

decisions.choice: "인치심을 받다" (L, B); "도장을 찍으셨습니다" (R)
decisions.reason: To be sealed is to be marked as God's own and kept safe (the meaning decision). "인치다" (to set a seal) is the established word for this and is still understood; Readable says it with the everyday "도장" (a seal stamp) and says what it shows, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "보증금" (L, B); "나머지도 반드시 주시겠다고 보증하는 첫 지불금" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a down payment that guarantees the rest (the meaning decision). "보증금" (a deposit) is the everyday business word; Readable says what it guarantees. The Spirit takes the honorific ("보증금이시며", "되십니다"), and the Korean "이 성령은" says "who", as the English does, though the Greek pronoun is neuter (the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "được đóng ấn" at every level
decisions.reason: A seal marks something as its owner's and keeps it safe (m5). "Đóng ấn" is the church word, as in the Vietnamese Romans (4:11, "ấn chứng"); "niêm phong" would suggest only closing something up.

decisions.choice: "Đấng bảo chứng" (L); "tiền đặt cọc bảo đảm" (B); "khoản tiền trả trước để bảo đảm phần còn lại" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a first installment that guarantees the rest (m8). Literal uses "Đấng" because the Spirit is a person; Balanced and Readable keep the picture of a deposit, which Vietnamese buyers know as "tiền đặt cọc".

decisions.choice: "sự cứu rỗi" (L, B); "Đức Chúa Trời cứu anh chị em" (R)
decisions.reason: "Sự cứu rỗi" is the church word for salvation, as in the Vietnamese Romans (1:16); Readable uses the verb "cứu".

decisions.choice: a primeira parcela
decisions.reason: The trade word means a first installment that binds the payer to pay the rest (m8). "A primeira parcela" keeps both halves of the picture: part now, the rest to come. "Penhor" now means pawning something, "sinal" is kept in this translation for signs, and "garantia" keeps only the second half, as the English decision says of "guarantee".

decisions.choice: ቀብድ (down payment, L, B); የመጀመሪያ ክፍያ (a first payment, R)
decisions.reason: "ቀብድ" is the everyday Amharic word for the part of the price paid at once to bind a sale, which is exactly the picture of meaning decision m8. "መያዣ" is something handed over and later returned, which the Spirit is not.

decisions.choice: የተስፋ ቃል (promise), kept apart from ተስፋ (hope)
decisions.reason: Amharic "ተስፋ" means both hope and promise. Where Paul's word is promise (epangelia), the text says "የተስፋ ቃል" or uses the verb "ተስፋ ሰጠ" (he promised), so that it is not read as hope (elpis), which comes beside it in 1:18 and 2:12.

decisions.choice: ንብረት (possession, L, B)
decisions.reason: God's own possession is his people; "ንብረት" says 'what belongs to someone' without the sense of money that "ገንዘብ" now has.

source.text: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ, ἀκούσας τὴν καθ’ ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τὴν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους, οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου, ἵνα ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ πατὴρ τῆς δόξης, δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ, πεφωτισμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εἰδέναι ὑμᾶς τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς κλήσεως αὐτοῦ, τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις, καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ κράτους τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι·

records.literal_gloss: Because of this I also, having heard of the among you faith in the Lord Jesus and the love the [love] toward all the holy [ones], \v 16 do not cease giving thanks for you, mention making at the prayers of me, \v 17 that the God of the Lord of us Jesus Christ, the Father of the glory, may give to you [a] spirit of wisdom and revelation in knowledge of him, \v 18 having been enlightened the eyes of the heart of you, for the to know you what is the hope of the calling of him, what the riches of the glory of the inheritance of him in the holy [ones], \v 19 and what the surpassing greatness of the power of him toward us the [ones] believing according to the working of the might of the strength of him, \v 20 which he worked in the Christ, having raised him from [the] dead and having seated [him] at [the] right [hand] of him in the heavenly [places], \v 21 above every rule and authority and power and lordship and every name being named, not only in the age this but also in the [one] coming;

en.L: Because of this I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus [that is] among you and the love [you have] for all the holy ones, \v 16 do not stop giving thanks for you, making mention [of you] in my prayers, \v 17 that the God of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, the Father of glory, may give you [the] Spirit of wisdom and revelation in [the] knowledge of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 18 the eyes of your heart having been enlightened, so that you may know what is the hope of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} calling, what [are] the riches of the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance in the holy ones, \v 19 and what [is] the surpassing greatness of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power toward us who believe, according to the working of the might of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength, \v 20 which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} worked in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, having raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from [the] dead and seated [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right [hand] in the heavenly [places], \v 21 far above every rule and authority and power and lordship and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in the [one] to come;
en.B: For this reason, since I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's holy people, \v 16 I have never stopped thanking God for you. I mention you whenever I pray, \v 17 asking the God of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the Father of glory, to give you the Spirit who brings wisdom and revelation as you come to know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 18 With the eyes of your heart opened to the light, you will know what hope {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} call holds out to you, how rich and glorious an inheritance {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy people, \v 19 and how far beyond all measure is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power at work for us who believe. It is the working of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty strength, \v 20 which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put to work in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead and set {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand in the heavenly places, \v 21 high above every ruler and authority, every power and dominion, and every name that can be named, not only in this age but in the age to come as well.
en.R: That is why, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all of God's people, \v 16 I have not stopped thanking God for you. I keep remembering you when I pray. \v 17 I ask the God of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the glorious Father, to give you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit, who makes you wise and shows you what God is like, so that you will truly know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 18 I ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to open the eyes of your heart and fill them with light, so that you will understand three things. You will know the hope {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave you when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called you. You will know how glorious and precious {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy people are to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: they are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own treasured inheritance. \v 19 And you will know how great {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power is for us who believe. Nothing can compare with it. It is the same mighty strength \v 20 that God used when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} from the dead. God gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the place of honor at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand in heaven. \v 21 There {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is far above every ruler and authority, every power and lord, and every name anyone can call on. He is above them, not only in this age but also in the age to come.

es.L: Por esto yo también, habiendo oído de la fe en el Señor Jesús [que hay] entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y del amor [que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}}] por todos los santos, \v 16 no dejo de dar gracias por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, haciendo mención [de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}] en mis oraciones, \v 17 para que el Dios de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, el Padre de la gloria, {{plural_you:les|os}} dé [el] Espíritu de sabiduría y de revelación en [el] conocimiento de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 18 habiendo sido iluminados los ojos de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón, para que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cuál es la esperanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} llamamiento, cuáles [son] las riquezas de la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} herencia en los santos, \v 19 y cuál [es] la incomparable grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder hacia nosotros los que creemos, según la acción del poderío de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fuerza, \v 20 que obró en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, resucitándolo de [entre los] muertos y sentándolo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha en los [lugares] celestiales, \v 21 muy por encima de todo gobierno y autoridad y poder y señorío y de todo nombre que se nombra, no solo en esta era sino también en la venidera;
es.B: Por esta razón, desde que oí de la fe que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} en el Señor Jesús y del amor que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} por todo el pueblo santo de Dios, \v 16 no he dejado de dar gracias a Dios por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} menciono siempre que oro, \v 17 y pido al Dios de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, el Padre de la gloria, que {{plural_you:les|os}} dé el Espíritu que trae sabiduría y revelación, para que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}} cada vez más. \v 18 Con los ojos de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón abiertos a la luz, {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} qué esperanza {{plural_you:les|os}} ofrece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} llamado, cuán rica y gloriosa es la herencia que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo santo, \v 19 y cuán inmensamente grande es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, que actúa a favor de nosotros los que creemos. Es la acción de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poderosa fuerza, \v 20 que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso en acción en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre los muertos y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} sentó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha en los lugares celestiales, \v 21 muy por encima de todo gobernante y autoridad, de todo poder y dominio, y de todo nombre que pueda nombrarse, no solo en esta era sino también en la era venidera.
es.R: Por eso, desde que supe de la fe que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} en el Señor Jesús y del amor que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} por todo el pueblo de Dios, \v 16 no he dejado de dar gracias a Dios por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Siempre {{plural_you:los|os}} recuerdo cuando oro. \v 17 Pido al Dios de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, el Padre glorioso, que {{plural_you:les|os}} dé {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu, que {{plural_you:los|os}} hace sabios y {{plural_you:les|os}} muestra cómo es Dios, para que de verdad {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}}. \v 18 Pido que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} abra los ojos de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón y los llene de luz, para que {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} tres cosas. {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} cuál es la esperanza que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dio cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó. {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} cuán glorioso y valioso es para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo santo: es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia herencia preciosa. \v 19 Y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} cuán grande es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder para nosotros los que creemos. Nada se puede comparar con él. Es la misma fuerza poderosa \v 20 que Dios usó cuando resucitó {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} de entre los muertos. Dios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dio el lugar de honor a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha en el cielo. \v 21 Allí {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} está muy por encima de todo gobernante y autoridad, de todo poder y señor, y de todo nombre que alguien pueda invocar. Está por encima de ellos, no solo en esta era sino también en la era venidera.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii mimi pia, nikiisha kusikia habari ya imani katika Bwana Yesu [iliyo] kwenu na upendo [mlio nao] kwa watakatifu wote, \v 16 siachi kushukuru kwa ajili yenu, nikiwataja katika maombi yangu, \v 17 ili Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Baba wa utukufu, awape Roho wa hekima na wa ufunuo katika kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, \v 18 macho ya moyo wenu yakiwa yametiwa nuru, ili mjue tumaini la wito {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ni nini, utajiri wa utukufu wa urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} katika watakatifu ni nini, \v 19 na ukubwa upitao kiasi wa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwetu sisi tunaoamini ni nini, kulingana na utendaji wa ukuu wa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \v 20 alioutenda katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, akimfufua kutoka kwa wafu na akimketisha upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia katika [mahali pa] mbinguni, \v 21 juu sana ya kila utawala na mamlaka na uweza na ubwana na kila jina litajwalo, si katika enzi hii tu bali pia katika ile ijayo;
sw.B: Kwa sababu hiyo, tangu niliposikia habari za imani yenu katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wenu kwa watu wote wa Mungu walio watakatifu, \v 16 sijaacha kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu. Ninawataja kila ninaposali, \v 17 nikimwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Baba wa utukufu, awape Roho aletaye hekima na ufunuo mnapozidi kumjua. \v 18 Macho ya moyo wenu yakiwa yamefunguliwa kwa nuru, mtajua tumaini ambalo wito {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unawapa, jinsi urithi alio nao katika watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu ulivyo tajiri na wenye utukufu, \v 19 na jinsi uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unaotenda kazi kwa ajili yetu sisi tunaoamini ulivyo mkuu kupita kipimo chochote. Ni utendaji wa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu, \v 20 ambazo alizitumia katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alipomfufua kutoka kwa wafu na kumketisha upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia katika ulimwengu wa mbinguni, \v 21 juu sana ya kila mtawala na mamlaka, kila uweza na ubwana, na kila jina linaloweza kutajwa, si katika enzi hii tu bali pia katika enzi ijayo.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu, tangu niliposikia juu ya imani yenu katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wenu kwa watu wote wa Mungu, \v 16 sijaacha kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu. Ninaendelea kuwakumbuka ninaposali. \v 17 Ninamwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Baba mwenye utukufu, awape Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, anayewapa hekima na kuwaonyesha jinsi Mungu alivyo, ili mpate kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kweli. \v 18 Ninamwomba afungue macho ya moyo wenu na kuyajaza nuru, ili mwelewe mambo matatu. Mtajua tumaini alilowapa alipowaita. Mtajua jinsi watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu walivyo na utukufu na thamani kubwa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}: wao ni urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe anaouthamini. \v 19 Tena mtajua jinsi uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulivyo mkuu kwa ajili yetu sisi tunaoamini. Hakuna kitu kinachoweza kulinganishwa nao. Ni nguvu zile zile kuu \v 20 ambazo Mungu alizitumia alipomfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kutoka kwa wafu. Mungu alimpa mahali pa heshima upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia mbinguni. \v 21 Huko {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} yuko juu sana ya kila mtawala na mamlaka, kila uweza na bwana, na kila jina ambalo watu wanaweza kuliitia. Yuko juu yao wote, si katika enzi hii tu bali pia katika enzi ijayo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi moi aussi, ayant entendu parler de la foi au Seigneur Jésus [qui est] parmi vous et de l’amour [que vous avez] pour tous les saints, \v 16 je ne cesse pas de rendre grâce pour vous, faisant mention [de vous] dans mes prières, \v 17 afin que le Dieu de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, le Père de la gloire, vous donne [l’]Esprit de sagesse et de révélation dans [la] connaissance de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 18 les yeux de votre cœur ayant été illuminés, pour que vous sachiez quelle est l’espérance de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} appel, quelle [est] la richesse de la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage dans les saints, \v 19 et quelle [est] l’extraordinaire grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance envers nous qui croyons, selon l’action du pouvoir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force, \v 20 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déployée dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ayant ressuscité d’entre les morts et fait asseoir à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite dans les [lieux] célestes, \v 21 au-dessus de toute principauté et autorité et puissance et seigneurie et de tout nom qui se nomme, non seulement dans cet âge-ci, mais aussi dans celui qui vient ;
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, depuis que j’ai entendu parler de votre foi au Seigneur Jésus et de votre amour pour tout le peuple saint de Dieu, \v 16 je ne cesse de remercier Dieu pour vous. Je pense à vous chaque fois que je prie, \v 17 et je demande au Dieu de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, le Père de la gloire, de vous donner l’Esprit qui apporte la sagesse et la révélation, pour que vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissiez. \v 18 Les yeux de votre cœur ouverts à la lumière, vous saurez quelle espérance {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} appel vous offre, quelle richesse et quelle gloire {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} possède en héritage dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple saint, \v 19 et combien {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, qui agit pour nous, les croyants, dépasse toute mesure. C’est l’action de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force toute-puissante, \v 20 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déployée dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité d’entre les morts et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a fait asseoir à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite dans les lieux célestes, \v 21 bien au-dessus de toute principauté et de toute autorité, de toute puissance et de toute souveraineté, et de tout nom qui puisse être nommé, non seulement dans cet âge-ci, mais aussi dans l’âge à venir.
fr.R: C’est pour cela que, depuis que j’ai entendu parler de votre foi dans le Seigneur Jésus et de votre amour pour tout le peuple de Dieu, \v 16 je n’ai pas cessé de remercier Dieu pour vous. Je pense toujours à vous quand je prie. \v 17 Je demande au Dieu de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, le Père glorieux, de vous donner {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit, qui vous rend sages et vous montre comment est Dieu, pour que vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissiez vraiment. \v 18 Je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demande d’ouvrir les yeux de votre cœur et de les remplir de lumière, pour que vous compreniez trois choses. Vous saurez quelle espérance {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a donnée quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a appelés. Vous saurez combien {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple saint est glorieux et précieux pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} : c’est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trésor. \v 19 Et vous saurez combien {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance est grande pour nous qui croyons. Rien ne peut se comparer à elle. C’est la même force puissante \v 20 que Dieu a utilisée quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a ressuscité le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} d’entre les morts. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné la place d’honneur, à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite, dans le ciel. \v 21 Là, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} est bien au-dessus de tous les chefs et de toutes les autorités, de toutes les puissances et de tous les seigneurs, et de tout nom que l’on peut invoquer. Il est au-dessus d’eux, non seulement dans le temps présent, mais aussi dans le temps à venir.

ko.L: 이 때문에 나도 여러분 가운데 있는 주 예수 안의 믿음과 모든 성도를 향한 사랑에 대하여 듣고, \v 16 여러분을 위하여 감사하기를 멈추지 않고, 내 기도 가운데 [여러분을] 기억합니다. \v 17 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님, 영광의 아버지께서 여러분에게 그분을 아는 지식 안에서 지혜와 계시의 영을 주시기를 [구합니다]. \v 18 [그리하여] 여러분의 마음의 눈이 밝아져서, 그분의 부르심의 소망이 무엇인지, 성도들 안에 있는 그분의 유산의 영광의 풍성함이 무엇인지, \v 19 그리고 그분의 힘의 능력의 활동을 따라 믿는 우리에게 [베푸시는] 그분의 능력의 엄청난 크심이 무엇인지 알게 되기를 [구합니다]. \v 20 그 능력을 그분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 행하셔서, 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리시고, 하늘에 [속한 곳들]에서 자기 오른편에 앉히셨습니다. \v 21 [그곳은] 모든 통치와 권세와 능력과 주권과, 이 세대뿐 아니라 오는 세대에도 일컬어지는 모든 이름보다 훨씬 위입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 나도 주 예수를 믿는 여러분의 믿음과 하나님의 모든 성도를 향한 여러분의 사랑에 대해 들은 뒤로, \v 16 여러분을 위해 하나님께 감사하기를 멈추지 않았습니다. 나는 기도할 때마다 여러분을 기억하며, \v 17 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님, 영광의 아버지께서 지혜와 계시의 영을 여러분에게 주셔서 여러분이 그분을 알게 해 주시기를 구합니다. \v 18 그래서 여러분의 마음의 눈이 밝아져, 그분의 부르심이 여러분에게 주는 소망이 무엇인지, 그분이 그분의 성도들 안에서 얻으시는 유산이 얼마나 풍성하고 영광스러운지, \v 19 그리고 믿는 우리를 위해 일하는 그분의 능력이 얼마나 엄청나게 큰지 알게 되기를 바랍니다. 그 능력은 그분의 크신 힘이 일하시는 것입니다. \v 20 하나님께서는 그 힘으로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 안에서 일하셔서, 그분을 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리시고, 하늘에서 그분의 오른편에 앉히셨습니다. \v 21 그곳은 모든 통치자와 권세, 모든 능력과 주권, 그리고 이 세대뿐 아니라 오는 세대에도 일컬어질 수 있는 모든 이름보다 훨씬 높은 자리입니다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 여러분이 주 예수를 믿고, 하나님의 모든 백성을 사랑한다는 소식을 들은 뒤로, \v 16 여러분 때문에 하나님께 감사하기를 멈추지 않았습니다. 나는 기도할 때마다 여러분을 기억합니다. \v 17 나는 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 하나님, 곧 영광스러운 아버지께서 여러분에게 그분의 영을 주시기를 구합니다. 성령께서 여러분을 지혜롭게 하시고 하나님이 어떤 분이신지 보여 주셔서, 여러분이 하나님을 참으로 알게 되기를 구합니다. \v 18 또 하나님께서 여러분의 마음의 눈을 열어 빛으로 채워 주셔서, 여러분이 세 가지를 깨닫게 해 주시기를 구합니다. 여러분은 하나님께서 여러분을 부르실 때 주신 소망이 무엇인지 알게 될 것입니다. 또 하나님의 거룩한 백성이 그분에게 얼마나 영광스럽고 귀한지 알게 될 것입니다. 그들은 그분의 소중한 유산입니다. \v 19 그리고 믿는 우리를 위한 그분의 능력이 얼마나 큰지 알게 될 것입니다. 그 무엇도 그 능력과 견줄 수 없습니다. 그것은 바로 그 크신 힘입니다. \v 20 하나님께서는 그 힘으로 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리셨습니다. 그리고 하늘에서 그분의 오른편 영광의 자리에 앉히셨습니다. \v 21 그곳에서 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 모든 통치자와 권세, 모든 능력과 주인, 그리고 사람들이 부르는 모든 이름보다 훨씬 높이 계십니다. 이 세대에서만이 아니라 오는 세대에서도 그러하십니다.

vi.L: Vì cớ đó, tôi cũng vậy, từ khi nghe về đức tin nơi Chúa Giê-xu [có] giữa anh chị em và tình yêu thương [anh chị em có] đối với tất cả các thánh đồ, \v 16 tôi không ngừng tạ ơn vì anh chị em, nhắc đến [anh chị em] trong những lời cầu nguyện của tôi, \v 17 để Đức Chúa Trời của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, là Cha vinh quang, ban cho anh chị em Thánh Linh của sự khôn ngoan và mặc khải trong sự hiểu biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 18 mắt của lòng anh chị em được soi sáng, để anh chị em biết niềm hy vọng của sự kêu gọi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là gì, sự giàu có của vinh quang cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong các thánh đồ là gì, \v 19 và quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lớn lao vượt bậc là thể nào đối với chúng ta là những người tin, theo sự vận hành của sức mạnh oai lực {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 20 là sức mạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thực hiện trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, khi khiến Đấng ấy sống lại từ [cõi] chết và cho Đấng ấy ngồi bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở các nơi trên trời, \v 21 vượt trên mọi bậc cai trị, thế lực, quyền năng, quyền chủ tể và mọi danh được xưng ra, không những trong đời này mà cả trong đời sắp đến;
vi.B: Vì vậy, từ khi tôi nghe về đức tin của anh chị em nơi Chúa Giê-xu và tình yêu thương của anh chị em đối với tất cả dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời, \v 16 tôi không ngừng tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời vì anh chị em. Tôi nhắc đến anh chị em mỗi khi cầu nguyện, \v 17 và xin Đức Chúa Trời của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, là Cha vinh quang, ban cho anh chị em Thánh Linh, Đấng ban sự khôn ngoan và mặc khải, để anh chị em ngày càng hiểu biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 18 Khi mắt của lòng anh chị em được mở ra cho thấy ánh sáng, anh chị em sẽ biết sự kêu gọi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem đến cho anh chị em niềm hy vọng nào, cơ nghiệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có trong dân thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giàu có và vinh quang dường nào, \v 19 và quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang hành động cho chúng ta là những người tin lớn lao vượt quá mọi sự đo lường dường nào. Đó là sự vận hành của sức mạnh oai lực {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \v 20 mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thực hiện trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} khi khiến Đấng ấy sống lại từ cõi chết và đặt Đấng ấy ngồi bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở các nơi trên trời, \v 21 vượt cao trên mọi bậc cai trị và thế lực, mọi quyền năng và quyền chủ tể, và mọi danh có thể xưng ra, không những trong đời này mà cả trong đời sắp đến.
vi.R: Vì vậy, từ khi tôi nghe về đức tin của anh chị em nơi Chúa Giê-xu và tình yêu thương của anh chị em dành cho tất cả dân thánh của Đức Chúa Trời, \v 16 tôi không ngừng cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời vì anh chị em. Tôi luôn nhớ đến anh chị em khi cầu nguyện. \v 17 Tôi cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, là Cha vinh quang, ban Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho anh chị em. Thánh Linh làm cho anh chị em khôn ngoan và cho anh chị em thấy Đức Chúa Trời là thế nào, để anh chị em thật sự biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 18 Tôi xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mở mắt lòng anh chị em và đổ đầy ánh sáng vào đó, để anh chị em hiểu được ba điều. Anh chị em sẽ biết niềm hy vọng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho anh chị em khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi anh chị em. Anh chị em sẽ biết dân thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh quang và quý báu thế nào đối với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: họ là cơ nghiệp quý báu của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \v 19 Và anh chị em sẽ biết quyền năng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho chúng ta là những người tin lớn lao dường nào. Không gì có thể so sánh được với quyền năng ấy. Đó cũng chính là sức mạnh lớn lao \v 20 mà Đức Chúa Trời đã dùng khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} khiến {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sống lại từ cõi chết. Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho Đấng ấy chỗ tôn quý bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở trên trời. \v 21 Tại đó {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ở cao hơn mọi kẻ cai trị và thế lực, mọi quyền năng và chúa tể, và mọi danh mà người ta có thể kêu cầu. Ngài ở trên tất cả những điều đó, không những trong đời này mà cả trong đời sắp đến.

pt.L: Por isso também eu, tendo ouvido da fé no Senhor Jesus [que há] entre vocês e do amor [que vocês têm] por todos os santos, \v 16 não deixo de dar graças por vocês, fazendo menção [de vocês] nas minhas orações, \v 17 para que o Deus do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, o Pai da glória, dê a vocês [o] Espírito de sabedoria e de revelação no pleno conhecimento {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \v 18 tendo sido iluminados os olhos do coração de vocês, para que vocês saibam qual é a esperança do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} chamado, quais [são] as riquezas da glória da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} herança nos santos, \v 19 e qual [é] a suprema grandeza do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder para conosco, os que cremos, segundo a atuação do poderio da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} força, \v 20 que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} exerceu no {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, tendo-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitado dentre [os] mortos e [{{deity_pronoun:o|O}}] feito sentar à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} direita nos [lugares] celestiais, \v 21 muito acima de todo governo e autoridade e poder e domínio e de todo nome que se nomeia, não só nesta era, mas também na [era] vindoura;
pt.B: Por isso, desde que ouvi falar da fé que vocês têm no Senhor Jesus e do amor de vocês por todo o povo santo de Deus, \v 16 nunca deixei de agradecer a Deus por vocês. Eu me lembro de vocês sempre que oro, \v 17 pedindo ao Deus do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, o Pai da glória, que dê a vocês o Espírito que traz sabedoria e revelação, à medida que vocês passam a conhecê-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}. \v 18 Com os olhos do coração abertos para a luz, vocês saberão que esperança o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} chamado lhes oferece, que herança rica e gloriosa {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tem no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo santo \v 19 e como está além de toda medida o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder que age em favor de nós, os que cremos. É a atuação da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} força poderosa, \v 20 que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs em ação {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} quando {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou dentre os mortos e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} fez sentar à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} direita nos lugares celestiais, \v 21 bem acima de todo governante e autoridade, de todo poder e domínio, e de todo nome que se possa nomear, não só nesta era, mas também na era que há de vir.
pt.R: Por isso, desde que ouvi falar da fé de vocês no Senhor Jesus e do amor que vocês têm por todo o povo de Deus, \v 16 não paro de agradecer a Deus por vocês. Sempre me lembro de vocês quando oro. \v 17 Peço ao Deus do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, o Pai glorioso, que dê a vocês o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito, que torna vocês sábios e mostra como Deus é, para que vocês {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} conheçam de verdade. \v 18 Peço que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} abra os olhos do coração de vocês e os encha de luz, para que vocês entendam três coisas. Vocês vão saber qual é a esperança que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a vocês quando os chamou. Vocês vão saber como o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo santo é glorioso e precioso para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}: esse povo é a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} própria herança, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} tesouro. \v 19 E vocês vão saber como é grande o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} poder em favor de nós, que cremos. Nada se compara a esse poder. É a mesma força poderosa \v 20 que Deus usou quando ressuscitou {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} dentre os mortos. Deus deu a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} o lugar de honra à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} direita no céu. \v 21 Ali {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} está muito acima de todo governante e autoridade, de todo poder e senhor, e de todo nome que alguém possa invocar. Ele está acima deles, não só nesta era, mas também na era que vai chegar.

am.L: ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በጌታ በኢየሱስ በእናንተ ዘንድ ያለውን እምነትና ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ያላችሁን ፍቅር ሰምቼ፣ \v 16 በጸሎቴ እያስታወስኳችሁ ስለ እናንተ ማመስገንን አላቋርጥም፤ \v 17 ይኸውም የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} አምላክ፣ የክብር አባት፣ እርሱን በማወቅ የጥበብንና የመገለጥን መንፈስ እንዲሰጣችሁ ነው፤ \v 18 የልባችሁ ዓይኖች በርተው፣ የመጥራቱ ተስፋ ምን እንደ ሆነ፣ በቅዱሳን ያለው የርስቱ ክብር ባለ ጠግነት ምን እንደ ሆነ፣ \v 19 እንደ ብርታቱ ጉልበት አሠራርም ለምናምን ለእኛ ያለው የኃይሉ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ታላቅነት ምን እንደ ሆነ ታውቁ ዘንድ ነው፤ \v 20 ይህንም [አሠራር] {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሑ}} ሠራ፤ ከሙታን አስነሣው፤ በሰማያዊ [ስፍራዎች] በቀኙ አስቀመጠው፤ \v 21 ከአለቅነትና ከሥልጣን፣ ከኃይልና ከጌትነት ሁሉ፣ በዚህ ዘመን ብቻ ሳይሆን በሚመጣውም ደግሞ ከሚጠራው ስም ሁሉ በላይ፤

decisions.choice: because of this: because of all God has done for them in Christ (verses 3-14)
alternatives: because of their faith and love only
decisions.reason: Διὰ τοῦτο looks back to the blessings just praised, and especially to the readers' share in them (verses 13-14). Hearing of their faith and love, Paul gives thanks and prays.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "and the love toward all the holy ones"
alternatives: "your faith in the Lord Jesus and toward all the holy ones", without "love"
decisions.reason: Several of the earliest manuscripts, among them P46 and Codex Vaticanus, do not have τὴν ἀγάπην, which leaves faith directed both to Jesus and to the holy ones. The words may have dropped out when a copyist's eye skipped between the two forms of the article. Faith and love together are Paul's usual pair (Colossians 1:4). Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of wisdom and revelation: the Holy Spirit, who gives wisdom and reveals God
alternatives: a spirit of wisdom: a wise and perceptive frame of mind
decisions.reason: πνεῦμα has no article and could mean a disposition ("a spirit of wisdom"). But only God's Spirit gives revelation, and Isaiah 11:2 promises the Messiah "the Spirit of wisdom". The readers have already received the Spirit (1:13), so Paul is praying that the Spirit will do this work in them, not that they receive him for the first time. On either reading the wisdom comes from God.

decisions.choice: the Father of glory: the glorious Father, to whom glory belongs
decisions.reason: Like "the glory of his grace" (verse 6), the phrase describes: the Father is glorious (compare "the God of glory", Acts 7:2; Psalm 29:3).

decisions.choice: in the knowledge of him: so that they come to know God more fully
decisions.reason: αὐτοῦ most naturally refers to God, the subject of the sentence. ἐπιγνώσει is knowledge that is personal and full, not information only (as in Colossians 1:9-10).

decisions.choice: the eyes of the heart enlightened: inner understanding opened, so that one sees what God has done
decisions.reason: In Scripture the heart is the center of thought and will, not only of feeling. Light for the eyes of the heart is understanding given by God (Psalm 19:9; 2 Corinthians 4:6). The participle describes the state Paul prays for, as part of the gift of verse 17.

decisions.choice: three things to know: the hope of his call, the riches of his inheritance, the greatness of his power
decisions.reason: The three questions each begin with τίς or τί ("what"). The first looks back to God's call, the second to what he will gain in his people, the third to his power now at work.

decisions.choice: the hope of his calling: the hope God gave them when he called them
decisions.reason: God's call brings a sure hope with it (4:4, "one hope of your calling"): the inheritance and the final redemption of verse 14.

decisions.choice: his inheritance in the holy ones: God's own inheritance, which is his people
alternatives: the inheritance God gives, which his people share
decisions.reason: κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ is "his", God's, inheritance. In the Old Testament Israel is the Lord's inheritance (Deuteronomy 9:29; 32:9), and verses 11 and 14 have spoken of God's people as his portion and his possession. The other reading takes it as the inheritance God gives, to be shared among his holy people (Colossians 1:12). Both are taught in Scripture; the question is which Paul means here.

decisions.choice: his power beyond all measure: Paul heaps up four words for strength to stress how great it is
decisions.reason: ὑπερβάλλον means "surpassing". Paul adds δυνάμεως, ἐνέργειαν, κράτους and ἰσχύος: power, working, might, strength. The words overlap; together they say that no power is greater than the one at work for believers.

decisions.choice: seated at his right hand: the place of honor and rule, as promised in Psalm 110:1
decisions.reason: "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool" (Psalm 110:1) is applied to Christ's exaltation again and again in the New Testament (Mark 12:36; Acts 2:34-35; Hebrews 1:13). Verse 22 goes on with a related psalm.

decisions.choice: rule, authority, power, lordship: ranks of unseen spiritual powers, and every other power that has a name
decisions.reason: Jewish writings of the time named ranks of angels and spirits with words like these. In Ephesians the rulers and authorities are in the heavenly places (3:10) and include powers hostile to God's people (6:12); Colossians 1:16 and 2:10 use the same terms. "Every name that is named" takes in any power anyone could name or call on, as people did in prayers and spells (Acts 19:13-19 shows such practice in Ephesus).

decisions.choice: this age and the age to come: the present time and the new age God will bring
decisions.reason: Jewish teaching divided history into the present age and the age to come (Matthew 12:32). Christ's rule over every power holds now and will hold in the age to come.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L), "the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}" in verse 20; {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of wisdom and revelation
alternatives: a spirit of wisdom and revelation
decisions.reason: All three levels follow m3. Literal brackets "the", since the Greek has no article.

decisions.choice: thanking God for you
decisions.reason: Thanks are given to God; Balanced and Readable say so, as Colossians 1:3 does.

decisions.choice: how rich and glorious an inheritance {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy people (B); how glorious and precious {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy people are to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: they are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own treasured inheritance (R)
alternatives: the riches of his glorious inheritance among the saints
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the sense chosen in m9.

decisions.reason: The same words as Colossians 1:16. "Ruler and authority" is kept at every level, as in the Ephesians word list, so that 3:10 and 6:12 can be traced back here.

decisions.reason: Readable uses the plainer phrase from the Ephesians word list.

decisions.choice: so that you will understand three things; Nothing can compare with it; God gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the place of honor at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand
alternatives: so that you may know what is the hope...; surpassing greatness; seated him at his right hand
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the prayer into short sentences, says plainly that there are three things to know (m7), and explains "surpassing" and "right hand" (m10, m11).

decisions.choice: every name anyone can call on
decisions.reason: Readable says what naming a power meant (m12).

decisions.reason: "Principado" now usually means a small state ruled by a prince, and "potestad" is old-fashioned. The words follow the English, so that the same powers can be traced in 3:10 and 6:12.

decisions.choice: resucitándolo ... sentándolo, with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek participles as Spanish gerunds, and a pronoun joined to the end of a verb cannot take a capital. Balanced and Readable use the separate pronoun "lo", which carries the setting.

decisions.reason: αἰῶνι is an age, a period of history (m13). "Ulimwengu" would blur it with "the world" of verse 4 ("ulimwengu"); "enzi" (era) names a time.

decisions.choice: utawala, mamlaka, uweza, ubwana (L); mtawala, mamlaka, uweza, ubwana (B); mtawala, mamlaka, uweza, bwana (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as the English list, kept at every level so that the powers of 3:10 and 6:12 can be traced back here. For the whole letter.

decisions.choice: principauté, autorité, puissance, seigneurie (L); principauté, autorité, puissance, souveraineté (B); chefs, autorités, puissances, seigneurs (R) (for the whole letter, 3:10, 6:12)
decisions.reason: The same French words as in Colossians 1:16 and 2:10, 2:15, so that the unseen powers (m12) can be traced through both letters. "Principauté" is the established French name for this rank of powers; Readable says "chefs" because "principauté" is now mostly a small country.

decisions.choice: l’action du pouvoir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force (L); l’action de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force toute-puissante (B)
decisions.reason: Paul heaps up words for strength (m10), and "puissance" is already used for the word in the line before; Literal keeps three distinct French words so the heaping can still be seen.

decisions.choice: "지혜와 계시의 영" (L, B); "그분의 영 ... 성령께서" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as the Holy Spirit, who gives wisdom and reveals God, and marks it uncertain. "영" keeps the Greek word at Literal and Balanced, where a reader may hear either the Spirit or a spirit; Readable says "성령", as the English Readable says "his Spirit".

decisions.choice: "통치, 권세, 능력, 주권" (L); "통치자와 권세, 능력과 주권" (B); "통치자와 권세, 능력과 주인" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:16: current words for the ranks of unseen powers, with "주권" (lordship) keeping the link with "주" (lord); "정사" and "주관" are older words no longer understood in this sense.

decisions.choice: Literal breaks the one Greek sentence of verses 15-21 into Korean sentences and repeats "[구합니다]" (I ask) after the three things to know
decisions.reason: As in verses 3-12, Korean cannot carry one verb-final sentence across seven verse markers; Literal keeps the clauses in order and brackets the verb of asking so the reader can see that verses 17-19 are all one prayer.

decisions.choice: "bậc cai trị, thế lực, quyền năng, quyền chủ tể" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The ranks of unseen powers (m12), in the words the Vietnamese Colossians (1:16; 2:10, 15) and Romans (8:38) use for the same Greek words, so the reader can follow them through Paul's letters (also 3:10; 6:12).

decisions.choice: "Thánh Linh của sự khôn ngoan và mặc khải" (L); "Thánh Linh, Đấng ban sự khôn ngoan và mặc khải" (B)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the spirit as the Holy Spirit, who gives wisdom and reveals God (m3), so it is capitalised; the lowercase "tinh thần" would choose the other reading.

decisions.choice: "Đấng ấy" for Christ (L, B), "Đức Chúa Trời" named as subject (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1:3-12, "Ngài" here stands for God, so Christ is named as "Đấng ấy" where the Greek has "him".

decisions.choice: governo, autoridade, poder, domínio (L); governante e autoridade, poder e domínio (B); governante e autoridade, poder e senhor (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "governante" (or "governo" at L) and "autoridade" at every level, so that 3:10 and 6:12 can be traced back here, as the English keeps "ruler and authority". "Principado" and "potestade" are old church words that most readers no longer understand.

decisions.choice: nesta era ... na era vindoura (L); na era que há de vir (B); na era que vai chegar (R)
decisions.reason: As in Romans 12:2: "era" names the present age and the age to come (m13); "século" is the old Bible word but now means a hundred years.

decisions.choice: አለቅነት፣ ሥልጣን፣ ኃይል፣ ጌትነት (L); ገዢ፣ ባለ ሥልጣን፣ ኃይል፣ ግዛት (B); ገዢ፣ ባለ ሥልጣን፣ ኃይል፣ ጌታ (R)
alternatives: the same abstract nouns at every level
decisions.reason: These are ranks of unseen powers (meaning decision m12). Literal keeps Paul's abstract nouns; Balanced and Readable name rulers and authorities, which Amharic hears as beings who rule, as the English does. The same words come back in 3:10 and 6:12.

decisions.choice: ዘመን (age): በዚህ ዘመን ... በሚመጣው ዘመን
decisions.reason: Paul's word is a span of time, the present age and the age to come (meaning decision m13); "ዘመን" says that, while "ዓለም" is kept for kosmos, the world (1:4; 2:2).

source.text: καὶ πάντα ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν κεφαλὴν ὑπὲρ πάντα τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ, ἥτις ἐστὶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ, τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν πληρουμένου.

records.literal_gloss: And all things he subjected under the feet of him, and him he gave [as] head over all things to the church, \v 23 which is the body of him, the fullness of the [one] the all things in all filling.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} subjected all things under {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet and gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [as] head over all things to the church, \v 23 which is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body, the fullness of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} who fills all things in all.
en.B: God has put all things under the feet of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, and has given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to the church to be head over all things. \v 23 The church is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body. It is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fullness, filled by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} who fills everything in every place and every way.
en.R: God has put everything under the feet of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rules over all things. God has made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} head over all things, and has given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as a gift to the church. \v 23 The church is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body, and it is full of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He fills all things completely.

es.L: Y sometió todas las cosas bajo {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} dio [como] cabeza sobre todas las cosas a la iglesia, \v 23 la cual es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo, la plenitud de aquel que llena todas las cosas en todo.
es.B: Dios ha puesto todas las cosas bajo los pies {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha dado a la iglesia como cabeza sobre todas las cosas. \v 23 La iglesia es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo. Es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} plenitud, llenada por {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, que lo llena todo en todo lugar y de todas las maneras.
es.R: Dios ha puesto todo bajo los pies {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} reine sobre todas las cosas. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha hecho cabeza sobre todas las cosas, y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} ha dado como regalo a la iglesia. \v 23 La iglesia es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo, y está llena de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Él llena por completo todas las cosas.

sw.L: Na vitu vyote alivitiisha chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, na alimtoa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [awe] kichwa juu ya vitu vyote kwa kanisa, \v 23 ambalo ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, utimilifu wa yule anayejaza vitu vyote katika vyote.
sw.B: Mungu ameweka vitu vyote chini ya miguu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, na amemtoa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kwa kanisa awe kichwa juu ya vitu vyote. \v 23 Kanisa ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Ni utimilifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, uliojazwa na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayejaza kila kitu kila mahali na kwa kila namna.
sw.R: Mungu ameweka kila kitu chini ya miguu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ili atawale juu ya vitu vyote. Mungu amemfanya kuwa kichwa juu ya vitu vyote, na amemtoa kama zawadi kwa kanisa. \v 23 Kanisa ni mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, naye amelijaza. Yeye hujaza vitu vyote kabisa.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a soumis toutes choses sous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a donné [pour] tête au-dessus de toutes choses à l’Église, \v 23 qui est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps, la plénitude de celui qui remplit tout en tous.
fr.B: Dieu a tout mis sous les pieds du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a donné à l’Église pour être la tête au-dessus de tout. \v 23 L’Église est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps. Elle est {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} plénitude, remplie par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, qui remplit tout, en tout lieu et de toute manière.
fr.R: Dieu a tout mis sous les pieds du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} règne sur toutes choses. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a fait chef de toutes choses, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a donné à l’Église comme un cadeau. \v 23 L’Église est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps, et elle est remplie de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Il remplit tout complètement.

ko.L: 그리고 [하나님께서] 모든 것을 그분의 발아래 복종시키시고, 그분을 모든 것 위에 머리로 교회에 주셨습니다. \v 23 교회는 그분의 몸이요, 모든 것 안에서 모든 것을 채우시는 분의 충만함입니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 모든 것을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 발아래 두시고, 그분을 모든 것 위에 머리로 세우셔서 교회에 주셨습니다. \v 23 교회는 그분의 몸입니다. 교회는 모든 곳에서 모든 것을 온갖 방법으로 채우시는 분으로 채워진, 그분의 충만함입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 모든 것을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 발아래 두셔서, 그분이 모든 것을 다스리시게 하셨습니다. 하나님께서는 그분을 모든 것 위의 머리로 삼으시고, 그분을 교회에 선물로 주셨습니다. \v 23 교회는 그분의 몸이며, 그분으로 가득 차 있습니다. 그분은 모든 것을 완전히 채우시는 분입니다.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt muôn vật dưới chân Đấng ấy, và ban Đấng ấy [làm] đầu trên muôn vật cho Hội Thánh, \v 23 là thân thể của Đấng ấy, là sự đầy trọn của Đấng làm đầy dẫy mọi sự trong mọi sự.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời đã đặt muôn vật dưới chân {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, và đã ban Đấng ấy cho Hội Thánh để làm đầu trên muôn vật. \v 23 Hội Thánh là thân thể của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Hội Thánh là sự đầy trọn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, được đầy dẫy bởi Đấng làm đầy dẫy mọi sự ở mọi nơi và trong mọi cách.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã đặt mọi vật dưới chân {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cai trị trên mọi vật. Đức Chúa Trời đã lập {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm đầu trên mọi vật, và đã ban {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Hội Thánh như một món quà. \v 23 Hội Thánh là thân thể của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và được đầy dẫy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài làm đầy dẫy mọi vật cách trọn vẹn.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deu [como] cabeça sobre todas as coisas à Igreja, \v 23 que é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} corpo, a plenitude {{deity_pronoun:daquele|Daquele}} que enche tudo em todos.
pt.B: Deus pôs todas as coisas debaixo dos pés {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deu à Igreja como cabeça sobre todas as coisas. \v 23 A Igreja é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} corpo. É a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} plenitude, cheia {{deity_pronoun:daquele|Daquele}} que enche tudo, em todo lugar e de todo modo.
pt.R: Deus pôs tudo debaixo dos pés {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} governe sobre todas as coisas. Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} fez cabeça sobre todas as coisas e {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deu como um presente à Igreja. \v 23 A Igreja é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} corpo e está cheia {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. Ele enche todas as coisas por completo.

am.L: ሁሉንም ከእግሩ በታች አስገዛ፤ እርሱንም ከሁሉ በላይ ራስ [አድርጎ] ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠ፤ \v 23 እርሷም አካሉ ናት፤ ሁሉን በሁሉ የሚሞላው ሙላቱ ናት።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ነገር {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} እግር በታች አስገዛ፤ በሁሉም ላይ ራስ እንዲሆንም ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ሰጠው። \v 23 ቤተ ክርስቲያን አካሉ ናት። እርሷ ሙላቱ ናት፤ ሁሉን በሁሉ ስፍራና በሁሉ መንገድ በሚሞላው የተሞላች ናት።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሁሉን ነገር {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሑ}} እግር በታች አደረገ፤ ይህም በሁሉ ላይ እንዲገዛ ነው። እግዚአብሔር በሁሉ ላይ ራስ አደረገው፤ ለቤተ ክርስቲያንም ስጦታ አድርጎ ሰጠው። \v 23 ቤተ ክርስቲያን አካሉ ናት፤ እርሱም ሞልቶባታል። እርሱ ሁሉን ነገር ፈጽሞ ይሞላል።

decisions.choice: he put all things under his feet: Psalm 8:7, applied to Christ
decisions.reason: Psalm 8:7 says of humankind, "you have put all things under his feet". Paul changes "you" to "he" and applies the line to Christ, the man in whom God's purpose for humankind is fulfilled, as 1 Corinthians 15:27 and Hebrews 2:6-9 also do. With Psalm 110:1 in verse 20, it pictures Christ ruling over every power.

decisions.choice: God gave Christ, head over all things, to the church
alternatives: God made Christ head over all things for the sake of the church
God made Christ head of the church
decisions.reason: τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ is the one Christ is given to: the head over all things is God's gift to the church, and rules for its good. That he is also head of the church follows in verse 23 (and 4:15; 5:23), but here "over all things" is the point.

decisions.choice: head: the one who rules over all, and the body's source of life
decisions.reason: κεφαλὴν here means authority "over all things"; with "his body" in verse 23 it also brings in the picture of the head that holds the body together and gives it growth (4:15-16; Colossians 1:18; 2:19).

decisions.choice: church: God's people as a whole, everywhere
decisions.reason: ἐκκλησίᾳ is the gathered people. In Ephesians it always means the whole church, Christ's one body (3:10, 21; 5:23-32).

decisions.choice: the church is Christ's fullness: filled by him and with him
alternatives: the church completes Christ, who would be incomplete without it
"the fullness" describes Christ, not the church
decisions.reason: πλήρωμα stands next to "his body" and most naturally describes the church. In Ephesians the church is what Christ fills: Paul prays they will be filled to all the fullness of God (3:19), and Christ gives gifts to bring the church to "the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ" (4:13). Colossians 2:9-10 says the same: in Christ dwells all the fullness, and in him believers have been filled. That Christ needs the church to complete him is possible grammatically but fits the rest of the letter poorly.

decisions.choice: who fills all things in every way: Christ is the one who fills
alternatives: who is being filled in every way (by God, or by the church)
decisions.reason: πληρουμένου can be passive ("being filled") or middle with an active sense ("filling"). The object τὰ πάντα shows that he fills something, and 4:10 says Christ ascended "so that he might fill all things". ἐν πᾶσιν means "in every way" or "in all places".

decisions.choice: God has put all things under the feet of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
alternatives: he subjected all things under his feet
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God, who subjects, and Christ, under whose feet all things are put, since the pronouns alone would be unclear.

decisions.choice: so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rules over all things; has given {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as a gift to the church
alternatives: gave him as head over all things to the church
decisions.reason: Readable says what the psalm picture means and makes plain that Christ is given to the church (m2).

decisions.choice: it is full of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He fills all things completely
alternatives: the fullness of him who fills all in all
decisions.reason: Readable states the sense chosen in m5 and m6 in plain words, using "full" and "fill" as the Ephesians word list allows.

decisions.choice: utimilifu
decisions.reason: "Ukamilifu" is completeness or perfection; "utimilifu" is fullness, being filled up, and is the word used for "the fullness of the times" in verse 10, so the two uses of πλήρωμα stay one word. Readable says it with the verb "kujaza" (fill).

decisions.choice: la tête (L, B), chef (R); l’Église, with a capital, for the whole church (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Tête" keeps the picture of head and body that the next verse and 4:15-16 and 5:23 build on (m3); Readable says "chef" for the ruling sense. As in Colossians, the capital in "l’Église" marks God’s people as a whole (m4), not one congregation or a building.

decisions.choice: "교회" for the church at every level, through the letter
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and Galatians: "교회" is the ordinary Korean word for God's people as a whole (the meaning decision) as well as for one congregation, and is plain enough for Readable.

decisions.choice: "Hội Thánh" for the church at every level (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: "Hội Thánh" is the word of the Vietnamese Colossians (1:18) and Romans; here it is God's people as a whole (m4).

decisions.choice: "sự đầy trọn" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The word the Vietnamese Colossians keeps for this Greek noun (1:19; 2:9), so the reader can follow it into 3:19 and 4:13.

decisions.choice: a Igreja, capitalised
decisions.reason: For the whole book. In Ephesians the word always means the whole church, Christ's one body (m4), so Portuguese writes "a Igreja" with a capital, as docs/portuguese-style.md section 6 sets it for the whole body of believers; "a igreja" would suggest one local congregation.

decisions.choice: አካል (body) for the church, with feminine agreement (እርሷ, ናት)
decisions.reason: As settled for Paul's letters, the body of Christ is "አካል"; "ሥጋ" is kept for flesh. "ቤተ ክርስቲያን" takes feminine agreement in Amharic, so the church is "እርሷ" through the letter.
